presentation.name: Design an xFuze integration before configuring it
presentation.summary: Designs an integration on the xFuze platform: which connector stage, workflow step, egress or task does what, and how it fails, replays, scales and rolls out.
benefits: Places each responsibility in a reader, mapper, validator, workflow step, egress or task, reusing existing plugins first
Sets what one event is, so failure and replay work per business record and stay within plugin memory limits
Decides what belongs on a connection and what in plugin configuration
Lists every failure with where it becomes visible, whether it alerts and whether replay is safe
Plans rollout and rollback as version selections per environment, with network access requested up front
